headline: Sat Kartar Life Reports 26% Revenue and 48% EBITDA Growth in H1 FY27
summary: Technology-enabled Ayurveda healthcare firm Sat Kartar Life Limited announced unaudited financial results for the half-year ending September 30, posting 26% revenue growth and a 48% increase in EBITDA.
why: Mid-cap healthcare companies report financial performance metrics to demonstrate commercial traction and operational scalability in niche markets.

impacts.name: Sat Kartar Life Limited
impacts.why: Strong revenue and EBITDA growth indicate accelerating operational performance.
